name: Leg Press
cue: Sit tall with your back flat on the pad. Push the plate away with your whole foot, then bend slowly back. Keep knees soft at the top.

name: Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine
cue: Feet low on the plate, heels free. Push through the balls of your feet, pause, then let your heels sink back slowly.

name: Leg Extensions
cue: Sit with the pad on your shins. Lift until your legs are nearly straight, then lower slowly. Small and steady wins.

name: Seated Leg Curl
cue: Sit tall, pad behind your ankles. Pull your heels down and back, then return slowly. Keep your hips still.

name: Barbell Squat
cue: Bar on your upper back, feet shoulder wide. Sit your hips back and down, chest tall, then stand up through your heels.

name: Smith Machine Squat
cue: Bar on your upper back, feet a step forward. Slide down the rails until thighs are level, then push up tall.

name: Standing Calf Raises
cue: Stand tall, balls of your feet on the step. Rise up onto your toes, pause, then lower slowly below the step.

name: Butt Lift (Bridge)
cue: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat. Lift your hips until your body makes one line, squeeze, then lower slowly.

name: Bodyweight Squat
cue: Feet shoulder wide, arms forward for balance. Sit back like into a chair, then stand tall. Knees track over toes.

name: Close-Grip Front Lat Pulldown
cue: Grip close, sit tall. Pull the bar to your upper chest, elbows down, then let it rise slowly.

name: Seated Cable Rows
cue: Sit tall, arms long. Pull the handle to your tummy, squeeze your shoulder blades, then reach forward slowly.

name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
cue: One knee on the bench, back flat. Pull the weight to your hip, then lower it all the way down.

name: Bent Over Barbell Row
cue: Hinge at the hips, back flat, knees soft. Pull the bar to your tummy, then lower it with control.

name: Hyperextensions (Back Extensions)
cue: Hips on the pad, arms crossed. Lower your chest slowly, then lift until your body is one straight line.

name: Butterfly
cue: Sit tall, arms on the pads. Bring the pads together in front of your chest, then open slowly.

name: Cable Chest Press
cue: Handles at chest height. Push forward until arms are long, then return slowly, chest tall the whole time.

name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
cue: Lie flat, feet on the floor. Lower the bar to your chest with control, then push it back up.

name: Pushups
cue: Hands under shoulders, body one line. Lower until elbows bend deep, then push the floor away. Knees down is a fine version.

name: Alternating Cable Shoulder Press
cue: One handle at shoulder height, stand tall. Push up until your arm is long, lower slowly, then swap sides.

name: Side Lateral Raise
cue: Weights by your sides. Lift out to shoulder height with soft elbows, then lower slowly. No swinging.

name: Dumbbell Alternate Bicep Curl
cue: Elbows tucked at your sides. Curl one weight up, then lower slowly. Swap sides each rep.

name: Machine Bicep Curl
cue: Elbows on the pad, sit tall. Curl the handles up, then lower slowly until arms are nearly straight.

name: Bench Dips
cue: Hands on the bench behind you, legs out. Lower by bending elbows, then push back up. Bend knees to make it gentler.

name: Triceps Pushdown
cue: Elbows tucked, cable in hand. Push down until your arms are straight, then let it rise slowly.

name: Air Bike
cue: Lie back, hands by your head. Bring elbow to opposite knee, swapping sides like pedalling. Slow beats fast.

name: Plank
cue: Forearms down, body one long line, tummy pulled in. Breathe slowly and hold. Knees down is a fine version.

name: Glute Kickback
cue: On all fours, back flat. Push one heel up and back, squeeze, then return. Swap sides each set.

name: 3/4 Sit-Up
cue: Lie on your back. Curl only part way up. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: 90/90 Hamstring
cue: Lie on your back. Straighten one leg up toward the sky. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
cue: Sit tall. The pad rests on your chest. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Ab Roller
cue: On all fours, back flat. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Adductor
cue: Lie face down, roller under you. Roll slowly over your inner thigh, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Adductor/Groin
cue: Lie on your back. Ease into your groin stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Advanced Kettlebell Windmill
cue: Stand tall. Reach one hand toward the floor, eyes on the weight held high. Then stand tall and swap sides.

name: All Fours Quad Stretch
cue: On all fours, back flat. Ease into your front of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Alternate Hammer Curl
cue: Stand tall. Swap sides as you go. A weight in each hand. Palms facing in. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Alternate Heel Touchers
cue: Lie on your back. Swap sides as you go. Knees bent, feet flat. Hold the position still and breathe slowly.

name: Alternate Incline Dumbbell Curl
cue: Sit tall. Set the bench on an incline. Swap sides as you go. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Alternate Leg Diagonal Bound
cue: Stand tall. Swap sides as you go. Leap from one foot to the other. Land with soft knees.

name: Alternating Deltoid Raise
cue: Stand tall. Swap sides as you go. Lift the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Alternating Floor Press
cue: Lie on your back. Swap sides as you go. Push the kettlebell up to your chest. Then lower slowly.

name: Alternating Hang Clean
cue: Stand tall. Start from a dead hang. Swap sides as you go. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly.

name: Alternating Kettlebell Press
cue: Stand tall. Swap sides as you go. Push the kettlebell up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Alternating Kettlebell Row
cue: Stand tall. Swap sides as you go. Pull the kettlebell. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Alternating Renegade Row
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Swap sides as you go. Feet shoulder wide. Pull the kettlebell. Then let it return slowly.

name: Ankle Circles
cue: Stand tall. Circle your ankle slowly, then the other way. Keep it slow and easy both ways.

name: Ankle On The Knee
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your ankle stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Anterior Tibialis-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your front of shin, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Anti-Gravity Press
cue: Palms forward. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Arm Circles
cue: Stand tall. Circle your shoulders slowly, then the other way. Keep it slow and easy both ways.

name: Arnold Dumbbell Press
cue: Sit tall. Turn the weights as you press. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Around The Worlds
cue: Lie back on the bench. Circle your arm all the way around. A weight in each hand. Hold the position still and breathe slowly.

name: Atlas Stone Trainer
cue: Stand tall. Hug the stone to your chest. Lift the load up to your chest, then set it back down.

name: Atlas Stones
cue: Stand tall. Hug the stone to your chest. Lift the load up onto the platform. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Axle Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Grip the thick axle bar. Feet hip wide. Lift the weight by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Back Flyes - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Open your arms out wide, then bring the band back together.

name: Backward Drag
cue: Stand tall. Walk backward for this one. Drag it backward, step by steady step. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Backward Medicine Ball Throw
cue: Stand tall. Throw the ball up and back with your whole body. Land soft, knees bent.

name: Balance Board
cue: Stand tall. Hold the position still and breathe slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Ball Leg Curl
cue: Lie on your back. Curl the ball up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Band Assisted Pull-Up
cue: Stand tall. Pull your body. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Band Good Morning
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Band Good Morning (Pull Through)
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall. Keep your back flat.

name: Band Hip Adductions
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Lift the band up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Band Pull Apart
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Pull the band to your chest. Then let it return slowly.

name: Band Skull Crusher
cue: Lie back on the bench. Bands add the pull. Hold the position still and breathe slowly.

name: Barbell Ab Rollout
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Roll the bar forward slowly, then pull it back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Barbell Ab Rollout - On Knees
cue: On all fours, back flat. Roll the bar forward slowly, then pull it back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Barbell Curl
cue: Stand tall. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Barbell Curls Lying Against An Incline
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat.

name: Barbell Full Squat
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Barbell Glute Bridge
cue: Lie on your back. The bar rests across your hips. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Guillotine Bench Press
cue: Stand tall. The bar comes down toward your neck. Push the bar forward until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Hack Squat
cue: Stand tall. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall. Keep your back flat.

name: Barbell Hip Thrust
cue: Lie on your back. The bar rests across your hips. Back against the wall. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Incline Bench Press - Medium Grip
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Incline Shoulder Raise
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Lunge
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Step out and lower down, then push back up.

name: Barbell Rear Delt Row
cue: Stand tall. Palms up. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Barbell Rollout from Bench
cue: Kneel tall. Roll the bar forward slowly, then pull it back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Barbell Seated Calf Raise
cue: Sit tall. The bar rests across your thighs. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Shoulder Press
cue: Sit tall. Palms forward. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Barbell Shrug
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms forward. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down.

name: Barbell Shrug Behind The Back
cue: Stand tall. The bar rests behind you. Feet shoulder wide. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down.

name: Barbell Side Bend
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Feet shoulder wide. Hold the position still and breathe slowly.

name: Barbell Side Split Squat
cue: Stand tall. Feet in a long stagger. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Barbell Squat To A Bench
cue: Stand tall. Tap the bench lightly each rep. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Barbell Step Ups
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Barbell Walking Lunge
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Feet shoulder wide. Step out and lower down, then push back up.

name: Battling Ropes
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Wave the ropes up and down, one arm then the other.

name: Bear Crawl Sled Drags
cue: Stand tall. Crawl slowly, with control. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Behind Head Chest Stretch
cue: Sit tall. Ease your elbows back, hands behind your head. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Bench Jump
cue: Stand tall. Jump up onto the step, then step back down. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bench Press - Powerlifting
cue: Lie back on the bench. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Bench Press - With Bands
cue: Lie back on the bench. Bands add the pull. Push the band up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Bench Press with Chains
cue: Lie back on the bench. Chains hang from the bar. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Bench Sprint
cue: Stand tall. Push off and swap your feet, quick and light. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bent-Arm Barbell Pullover
cue: Lie back on the bench. Elbows stay bent the whole way. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly.

name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
cue: Stand tall. Elbows stay bent the whole way. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Bent-Knee Hip Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bent Over Dumbbell Rear Delt Raise With Head On Bench
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. A weight in each hand. Lift the weights toward the floor. Then lower slowly.

name: Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Pull yourself up toward the floor. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Bent Over One-Arm Long Bar Row
cue: Stand tall. Work one arm at a time. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly.

name: Bent Over Two-Arm Long Bar Row
cue: Stand tall. Both arms work together. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly. Keep your knees soft.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row
cue: Stand tall. One weight in each hand. A weight in each hand. Palms up. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Bent Over Two-Dumbbell Row With Palms In
cue: Stand tall. One weight in each hand. A weight in each hand. Palms facing in. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Bent Press
cue: Stand tall. Push the kettlebell until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bicycling
cue: Sit on the bike, seat set for you. Pedal at a steady pace you can keep. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Bicycling, Stationary
cue: Sit on the stationary bike, seat set for you. Pedal at a steady pace you can keep. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Board Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Squeeze your shoulder blades together.

name: Body-Up
cue: Stand tall. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Body Tricep Press
cue: Stand tall. Feet together. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bodyweight Flyes
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Open your arms out wide, then bring the bar back together.

name: Bodyweight Mid Row
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Pull your body to your chest. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bodyweight Walking Lunge
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Step out and lower down, then push back up. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Bosu Ball Cable Crunch With Side Bends
cue: Lie on your back. The dome sits under your back. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Bottoms-Up Clean From The Hang Position
cue: Stand tall. Start from a dead hang. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly.

name: Bottoms Up
cue: Lie on your back. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Box Jump (Multiple Response)
cue: Stand tall. Keep them coming, no pause. Jump up onto the step, then step back down. Land with soft knees.

name: Box Skip
cue: Stand tall. Skip up onto the box, one foot then the other. Land with soft knees.

name: Box Squat
cue: Stand tall. Touch the box lightly each time. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Box Squat with Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Touch the box lightly each time. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Box Squat with Chains
cue: Stand tall. Chains hang from the bar. Touch the box lightly each time. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Brachialis-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your upper arm, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Bradford/Rocky Presses
cue: Sit tall. Press up front, then behind your neck, turn by turn. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Butt-Ups
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Forearms flat on the floor. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly.

name: Cable Crossover
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Bring the handles together in front of your chest. Then open back out slowly.

name: Cable Crunch
cue: Kneel tall. The rope rests beside your face. The rope rests over your shoulders. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Deadlifts
cue: Stand tall. Lift the handle by standing up tall. Then lower slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Cable Hammer Curls - Rope Attachment
cue: Stand tall. Palms facing in. Curl the handle up. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Cable Hip Adduction
cue: Stand tall. Step out and lower down, then push back up. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cable Incline Pushdown
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Push the handle until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Cable Incline Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Palms forward. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Cable Internal Rotation
cue: Sit tall. Turn the handle slowly to one side, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cable Iron Cross
cue: Stand tall. Arms stay long, out to your sides. Pull the handle to your sides. Then let it return slowly.

name: Cable Judo Flip
cue: Stand tall. Throw the handle down across your body. Lift and flip it over, then reset your grip.

name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Palms forward. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Cable One Arm Tricep Extension
cue: Stand tall. Work one arm at a time. Palms up. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Cable Preacher Curl
cue: Stand tall. Set up at the preacher bench. Curl the handle up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
cue: Stand tall. Open your arms out wide, then bring them back together. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cable Reverse Crunch
cue: Lie on your back. Lift your hips and knees toward your chest. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Stand tall. Start with the weight overhead. Palms facing in. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Cable Rope Rear-Delt Rows
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cable Russian Twists
cue: Stand tall. Turn slowly from your middle, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cable Seated Crunch
cue: Sit tall. The rope rests over your shoulders. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Cable Seated Lateral Raise
cue: Sit tall. Palms facing in. Lift the handle to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat.

name: Cable Shoulder Press
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Push the handle up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Cable Shrugs
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down.

name: Cable Wrist Curl
cue: Stand tall. Palms up. Curl the handle up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Calf-Machine Shoulder Shrug
cue: Stand tall. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Calf Press
cue: Stand tall. Push the pad away with the balls of your feet. Then let it come back slowly.

name: Calf Raise On A Dumbbell
cue: Stand tall. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Calf Raises - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly.

name: Calf Stretch Elbows Against Wall
cue: Stand tall by a wall. Ease into your calf stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Calf Stretch Hands Against Wall
cue: Stand tall by a wall. Fold forward slowly from your hips. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Calves-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your calves, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Car Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Feet hip wide. Palms facing in. Lift the weight by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Car Drivers
cue: Stand tall. Turn the weight like a steering wheel. Turn slowly from your middle, then turn back.

name: Carioca Quick Step
cue: Stand tall. Pull with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Cat Stretch
cue: On all fours, back flat. Round your back slowly. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Catch and Overhead Throw
cue: Stand tall. Throw the ball overhead to your partner. Land soft, knees bent. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Chain Handle Extension
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Chain Press
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Chair Leg Extended Stretch
cue: Sit tall on a chair. Ease into your back of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Chair Lower Back Stretch
cue: Sit tall on a chair. Ease into your lower back stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Chair Squat
cue: Stand tall. Lower until you just touch the chair. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Chair Upper Body Stretch
cue: Sit tall on a chair. Ease into your shoulders stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Chest And Front Of Shoulder Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your shoulder stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Chest Push from 3 point stance
cue: Stand tall. Push with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick. Keep your back flat.

name: Chest Push (multiple response)
cue: Kneel tall. Keep them coming, no pause. Push with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick.

name: Chest Push (single response)
cue: Kneel tall. Jump on one leg, then swap sides. Keep your steps light and quick. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Chest Push with Run Release
cue: Stand tall. Push with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick. Keep your back flat. Drive up with power.

name: Chest Stretch on Stability Ball
cue: Rest on the ball. Ease into your chest stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Child's Pose
cue: On all fours, back flat. Sit your hips back to your heels. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Chin-Up
cue: Keep your chest tall. Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms up. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Chin To Chest Stretch
cue: Sit tall. Ease your chin down toward your chest. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Circus Bell
cue: Stand tall. Lift your arms up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Clean
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Clean Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Feet shoulder wide. Palms forward. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Clean Pull
cue: Stand tall. Just the pull, no catch. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Clean Shrug
cue: Stand tall. Start from the hang, bar at your thighs. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down.

name: Clean and Jerk
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Lift the bar to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. Then lower slowly.

name: Clean and Press
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Palms forward. Lift the bar to your shoulders, then press it overhead. Then lower slowly.

name: Clean from Blocks
cue: Stand tall. Start with the bar on blocks. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Clock Push-Up
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Grip close. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Press
cue: Stand tall. Grip close. Push the weights to your chest. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl with Band
cue: Stand tall. The bar has angled grips. Grip close, palms up. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. The bar has angled grips. Grip close. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip EZ Bar Curl
cue: Stand tall. The bar has angled grips. Grip close. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Hands close under your chest. Grip close. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Close-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
cue: Stand tall. Grip close. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly. Keep your elbows tucked in.

name: Cocoons
cue: Lie on your back. Roll back and tuck in, then stretch out long. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly.

name: Conan's Wheel
cue: Stand tall. Carry it cradled in your arms. Lift your body up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Concentration Curls
cue: Sit tall. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
cue: Lie on your back. Reach toward the opposite side. Feet flat on the floor. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Cross Body Hammer Curl
cue: Stand tall. Reach toward the opposite side. A weight in each hand. Palms facing in. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Cross Over - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Palms forward. Lift the band across your body. Then lower slowly.

name: Crossover Reverse Lunge
cue: Stand tall. Turn your body slowly to one side. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Crucifix
cue: Stand tall. Hold the weights out to your sides, steady. Breathe normally, then set them down slowly.

name: Crunch - Hands Overhead
cue: Lie on your back. Start with the weight overhead. Feet flat on the floor. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Crunch - Legs On Exercise Ball
cue: Lie on your back. Heels rest on the ball. Knees bent, feet flat. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Crunches
cue: Lie back on the bench. Feet flat on the floor. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Cuban Press
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Palms forward. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Dancer's Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your lower back stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Dead Bug
cue: Lie on your back. Hold the position still and breathe slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Deadlift with Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Deadlift with Chains
cue: Stand tall. Chains hang from the bar. Feet hip wide. Palms forward. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Decline Close-Grip Bench To Skull Crusher
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Grip close. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Decline Crunch
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Decline Dumbbell Flyes
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Open your arms out wide, then bring the weights back together.

name: Decline Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Decline EZ Bar Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Straighten your arms toward the floor, then bend slowly back.

name: Decline Oblique Crunch
cue: Turn a little as you curl. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Decline Push-Up
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Decline Reverse Crunch
cue: Feet together. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Decline Smith Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Push the handles up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Deficit Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Stand on a low step for this one. Feet hip wide. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Depth Jump Leap
cue: Stand tall. Drop from the step, land, then jump straight up. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Dip Machine
cue: Sit tall. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Dips - Chest Version
cue: Hold the bars, arms long. Lean forward a little. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up.

name: Dips - Triceps Version
cue: Stand tall. Stay tall and upright. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up.

name: Donkey Calf Raises
cue: Stand tall. Hinge forward, weight resting on your hips. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly.

name: Double Kettlebell Alternating Hang Clean
cue: Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Stand tall. Start from a dead hang. Swap sides as you go. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly.

name: Double Kettlebell Jerk
cue: Stand tall. One weight in each hand. Lift the bar to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. Then lower slowly.

name: Double Kettlebell Push Press
cue: Stand tall. One weight in each hand. Push the kettlebell overhead. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Double Kettlebell Snatch
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. One weight in each hand. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly.

name: Double Kettlebell Windmill
cue: One weight in each hand. Stand tall. Reach one hand toward the floor, eyes on the weight held high. Then stand tall and swap sides.

name: Double Leg Butt Kick
cue: Stand tall. Kick your heel toward your seat. Push with power, then reset calmly. Land with soft knees.

name: Downward Facing Balance
cue: Lie face down. Press gently and hold the position still. Breathe normally, then let go slowly.

name: Drag Curl
cue: Stand tall. Palms up. Curl the bar to your sides. Then lower slowly. Keep your elbows tucked in.

name: Drop Push
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Drop from the step, land, then jump straight up. Land with soft knees.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. A weight in each hand. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bench Press with Neutral Grip
cue: Palms facing in. Lie back on the bench. A weight in each hand. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Clean
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. A weight in each hand. Lift the weights toward the floor. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Floor Press
cue: Stand tall. Lie on the floor for this one. Push the weights until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Flyes
cue: Lie back on the bench. Open your arms out wide, then bring the weights back together.

name: Dumbbell Incline Row
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. A weight in each hand. Palms facing in. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Incline Shoulder Raise
cue: Sit tall. Set the bench on an incline. Palms forward. Lift the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lunges
cue: Stand tall. Weights held at your sides. Step out and lower down, then push back up.

name: Dumbbell Lying One-Arm Rear Lateral Raise
cue: Lie back on the bench. Work one arm at a time. Palms up. Lift the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation
cue: Lie back on the bench. Lift the weights toward the floor. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Lateral Raise
cue: Lie back on the bench. A weight in each hand. Palms up. Lift the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Lying Supination
cue: Lie back on the bench. Lift the weights toward the floor. Then lower slowly. Hold the top for a breath.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Shoulder Press
cue: Sit tall. Work one arm at a time. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Triceps Extension
cue: Sit tall. Work one arm at a time. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Dumbbell One-Arm Upright Row
cue: Stand tall. Work one arm at a time. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift the weights up. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Dumbbell Rear Lunge
cue: Stand tall. Weights held at your sides. Step back and lower down, then push back up.

name: Dumbbell Scaption
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Lift the weights toward the floor. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Seated Box Jump
cue: Sit tall. Start seated on the box. Explode up from the box into a jump. Land with soft knees.

name: Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise
cue: Sit tall. Work one leg at a time. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
cue: Sit tall. A weight in each hand. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
cue: Stand tall. Palms up. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
cue: Stand tall. Hold the position still and breathe slowly. Keep your back flat. Keep your head in line.

name: Dumbbell Squat
cue: Stand tall. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall. Keep your head in line.

name: Dumbbell Squat To A Bench
cue: Stand tall. Tap the bench lightly each rep. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Dumbbell Step Ups
cue: Stand tall. Lift the weights up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Dumbbell Tricep Extension -Pronated Grip
cue: Lie back on the bench. Weights held at your sides. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Dynamic Back Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your back stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Dynamic Chest Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your chest stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
cue: Stand tall. The bar has angled grips. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly. Keep your elbows tucked in.

name: EZ-Bar Skullcrusher
cue: Lie back on the bench. The bar has angled grips. Lift the bar toward the floor. Then lower slowly.

name: Elbow Circles
cue: Stand tall. Circle your elbow slowly, then the other way. Keep it slow and easy both ways.

name: Elbow to Knee
cue: Lie on your back. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Elbows Back
cue: Stand tall. Open your chest, arms reaching back. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Elevated Back Lunge
cue: Stand tall. Step back and lower down, then push back up. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Elevated Cable Rows
cue: Sit tall. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Elliptical Trainer
cue: Step onto the elliptical. Glide at a steady pace you can keep. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Exercise Ball Crunch
cue: Stand tall. Heels rest on the ball. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Exercise Ball Pull-In
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Feet shoulder wide. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Extended Range One-Arm Kettlebell Floor Press
cue: Lie on your back. One knee crosses over your body. Push the kettlebell up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: External Rotation
cue: Lie back on the bench. Turn your thumbs up as you go. Turn the weights slowly to one side, then turn back.

name: External Rotation with Band
cue: Stand tall. Turn your thumbs up as you go. Turn the band slowly to one side, then turn back.

name: External Rotation with Cable
cue: Stand tall. Turn your thumbs up as you go. Turn the handle slowly to one side, then turn back.

name: Face Pull
cue: Stand tall. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Farmer's Walk
cue: Stand tall. Walk tall and steady, arms swinging easy. Keep your back flat. Keep your head in line.

name: Fast Skipping
cue: Stand tall. Swing your body to help the pull. Jump up, using your arms to help. Land soft, knees bent.

name: Finger Curls
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms up. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Flat Bench Cable Flyes
cue: Lie back on the bench. Open your arms out wide, then bring them back together. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
cue: Lie back on the bench. Palms forward. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Flat Bench Lying Leg Raise
cue: Lie back on the bench. Palms forward. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat.

name: Flexor Incline Dumbbell Curls
cue: Sit tall. Set the bench on an incline. Weights held at your sides. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Floor Glute-Ham Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift your body up. Then lower slowly. Keep your body tall and still. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Floor Press
cue: Stand tall. Lie on the floor for this one. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Floor Press with Chains
cue: Stand tall. Chains hang from the bar. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Flutter Kicks
cue: Lie back on the bench. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Foot-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your foot sole, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Forward Drag with Press
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Frankenstein Squat
cue: Stand tall. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Freehand Jump Squat
cue: Stand tall. Explode up from the start. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Frog Hops
cue: Stand tall. Sit back into a deep squat and hold. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Frog Sit-Ups
cue: Stand tall. Curl all the way up. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Front Barbell Squat
cue: Stand tall. The bar rests on your front shoulders. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Front Barbell Squat To A Bench
cue: Tap the bench lightly each rep. Stand tall. The bar rests on your front shoulders. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Front Box Jump
cue: Stand tall. Touch the box lightly each time. Jump up onto the step, then step back down. Land with soft knees.

name: Front Cable Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift the handle in front of you to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Front Cone Hops (or hurdle hops)
cue: Stand tall. Hop over the hurdles, one after another. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Front Dumbbell Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift the weights in front of you to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Front Incline Dumbbell Raise
cue: Sit tall. Set the bench on an incline. Palms forward. Lift the weights in front of you to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Front Leg Raises
cue: Stand tall. Swing one leg forward and back, gently. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Front Plate Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift your arms up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return. Hold the top for a breath.

name: Front Raise And Pullover
cue: Lie back on the bench. Palms forward. Lift the bar in front of you to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
cue: Fingertips under the bar, elbows high. Stand tall. The bar rests on your front shoulders. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Front Squats With Two Kettlebells
cue: Stand tall. The bells rests on your front shoulders. One weight in each hand. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Front Two-Dumbbell Raise
cue: Stand tall. One weight in each hand. Lift the weights in front of you to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Full Range-Of-Motion Lat Pulldown
cue: Stand tall. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Keep your chest tall. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Gironda Sternum Chins
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms up. Pull yourself up toward the floor. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Glute Ham Raise
cue: Lie face down. Lower yourself with the backs of your thighs. Lift the handles up. Then lower slowly.

name: Goblet Squat
cue: Stand tall. Hold one weight at your chest. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Good Morning
cue: Stand tall. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall. Keep your knees soft.

name: Good Morning off Pins
cue: Stand tall. Start from the safety pins. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Gorilla Chin/Crunch
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms up. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Groin and Back Stretch
cue: Sit tall. Bend your knees, feet flat. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Groiners
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Ease into your groin stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Hack Squat
cue: Stand tall. Back flat on the pad. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Hammer Curls
cue: Stand tall. Palms facing in. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Hammer Grip Incline DB Bench Press
cue: Palms facing in. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Hamstring-SMR
cue: Sit with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your back of thigh, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Hamstring Stretch
cue: Lie on your back. Ease into your back of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Handstand Push-Ups
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Push your body up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Hang Clean
cue: Stand tall. Start from a dead hang. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Hang Clean - Below the Knees
cue: Stand tall. Start with the bar below your knees. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Hang Snatch
cue: Stand tall. Start from a dead hang. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Hang Snatch - Below Knees
cue: Stand tall. Start with the bar below your knees. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Hanging Bar Good Morning
cue: Stand tall. The bar sits at your hips on the rack. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Hanging Pike
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Feet together. Palms forward. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Heaving Snatch Balance
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Heave the bar up as you drop under. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Heavy Bag Thrust
cue: Stand tall. Drive into the bag with your shoulder. Lift with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick.

name: High Cable Curls
cue: Stand tall. Curl the handle up. Then lower slowly. Only your forearms move. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Hip Circles (prone)
cue: On all fours, back flat. Circle your hip slowly, then the other way. Keep it slow and easy both ways.

name: Hip Extension with Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Keep your chest tall.

name: Hip Flexion with Band
cue: Stand tall. Bend slowly as far as feels easy. Then straighten slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Hip Lift with Band
cue: Stand tall. Feet flat on the floor. Lift the band up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Hug A Ball
cue: Rest on the ball. Open your legs wide and ease into the middle. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Hug Knees To Chest
cue: Lie on your back. Ease into your chest stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Hurdle Hops
cue: Feet shoulder wide. Stand tall. Hop over the hurdles, one after another. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Hyperextensions With No Hyperextension Bench
cue: Lie face down on the bench. Lift your legs behind you, together. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat.

name: IT Band and Glute Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Reach one arm across your body. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Iliotibial Tract-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your outer thigh, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Inchworm
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Ease into your back of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Incline Barbell Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Palms forward. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Hold the top for a breath.

name: Incline Bench Pull
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. A weight in each hand. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly.

name: Incline Cable Chest Press
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. Push the handle forward until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Cable Flye
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Open your arms out wide, then bring them back together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench With Palms Facing In
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Palms facing in. Hold the position still and breathe slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. A weight in each hand. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Open your arms out wide, then bring the weights back together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Flyes - With A Twist
cue: A weight in each hand. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Open your arms out wide, then bring the weights back together.

name: Incline Dumbbell Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Hammer Curls
cue: Sit tall. Set the bench on an incline. A weight in each hand. Feet together. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Inner Biceps Curl
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Push-Up
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Set the bench on an incline. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Push-Up Close-Grip
cue: Grip close. Face down, hands under your shoulders. Set the bench on an incline. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Push-Up Depth Jump
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Drop from the step, land, then jump straight up. Keep your steps light and quick.

name: Incline Push-Up Medium
cue: Feet shoulder wide. Face down, hands under your shoulders. Set the bench on an incline. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Push-Up Reverse Grip
cue: Use a reverse grip. Face down, hands under your shoulders. Set the bench on an incline. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Incline Push-Up Wide
cue: Hands wide apart. Face down, hands under your shoulders. Set the bench on an incline. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Intermediate Groin Stretch
cue: Lie on your back. Ease into your groin stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch. Feel it in your groin.

name: Intermediate Hip Flexor and Quad Stretch
cue: Lie face down. Ease into your front of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Internal Rotation with Band
cue: Stand tall. Turn the band slowly to one side, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Inverted Row
cue: Stand tall. Lie under the bar, body in one line. Pull your body. Then let it return slowly.

name: Inverted Row with Straps
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Iron Crosses (stretch)
cue: Lie face down. Bring one leg across behind you. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Isometric Chest Squeezes
cue: Stand tall. Squeeze your hands together at your chest. Breathe normally, then let go slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Front And Back
cue: Stand tall. Press gently with your hand and hold, no movement. Breathe normally, then let go slowly.

name: Isometric Neck Exercise - Sides
cue: Stand tall. Press on the side of your head and hold, no movement. Breathe normally, then let go slowly.

name: Isometric Wipers
cue: Swing your legs side to side like wipers. Face down, hands under your shoulders. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: JM Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Half press, half extension. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Jackknife Sit-Up
cue: Lie on your back. Reach your hands toward your feet as you fold. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Janda Sit-Up
cue: Stand tall. Curl all the way up. Feet flat on the floor. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Jefferson Squats
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms facing in. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Jerk Balance
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead and steady yourself. Lift the bar to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. Then lower slowly.

name: Jerk Dip Squat
cue: Stand tall. Dip straight down, then drive up. Lift the bar to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. Then lower slowly.

name: Jogging, Treadmill
cue: Step onto the treadmill. Jog lightly at a steady pace. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Keg Load
cue: Stand tall. Hug the keg to your chest. Lift the load up onto the platform. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kettlebell Arnold Press
cue: Stand tall. Turn the weights as you press. Push the kettlebell up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Dead Clean
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Start each rep from a dead stop. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Figure 8
cue: Stand tall. Pass the bell in a loop around your legs, hand to hand. Keep your back flat.

name: Kettlebell Halo
cue: Stand tall. Feet hip wide. Circle the kettlebell slowly around your head. Then circle the other way.

name: Kettlebell Halo with Overhead Extension
cue: Stand tall. Start with the weight overhead. Feet hip wide. Circle the kettlebell slowly around your head. Then circle the other way.

name: Kettlebell Hang Clean
cue: Stand tall. Start from a dead hang. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly. Keep your eyes forward.

name: Kettlebell One-Legged Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Work one leg at a time. Lift the kettlebell by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Overhead Triceps Extension
cue: Stand tall. Start with the weight overhead. Feet hip wide. Straighten your arms overhead, then bend slowly back.

name: Kettlebell Pass Between The Legs
cue: Stand tall. Pass the bell between your legs, hand to hand. Keep your back flat. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kettlebell Pirate Ships
cue: Stand tall. Turn slowly from your middle, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return. Pause at the top.

name: Kettlebell Pistol Squat
cue: Stand tall. One leg reaches forward as you squat. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Kettlebell Seated Press
cue: Sit tall. Push the kettlebell overhead. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kettlebell Seesaw Press
cue: Stand tall. Press one side, then the other. Push the kettlebell up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Kettlebell Sumo High Pull
cue: Stand tall. Take a wide stance, toes turned out. Pull the kettlebell. Then let it return slowly.

name: Kettlebell Thruster
cue: Stand tall. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Lunge style)
cue: Lie on your back. Step out and lower down, then push back up. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kettlebell Turkish Get-Up (Squat style)
cue: Lie on your back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kettlebell Windmill
cue: Stand tall. Reach one hand toward the floor, eyes on the weight held high. Then stand tall and swap sides. Pause at the top.

name: Kipping Muscle Up
cue: Stand tall. Swing your body to help the pull. Pull hard and push up over the bar in one go. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Knee Across The Body
cue: Lie on your back. Reach one arm across your body. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Knee Circles
cue: Stand tall. Circle your knee slowly, then the other way. Keep it slow and easy both ways.

name: Knee/Hip Raise On Parallel Bars
cue: Stand tall. Lift your legs up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return. Hold the top for a breath.

name: Knee Tuck Jump
cue: Stand tall. Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest. Land with soft knees. Keep your knees soft.

name: Kneeling Arm Drill
cue: Kneel tall. Pull with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kneeling Cable Crunch With Alternating Oblique Twists

name: Kneeling Cable Triceps Extension
cue: Kneel tall. Palms forward. Straighten your arms toward the floor, then bend slowly back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kneeling Forearm Stretch
cue: Kneel tall. Ease into your forearm stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Kneeling High Pulley Row
cue: Kneel tall. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Kneeling Hip Flexor
cue: Kneel tall. Ease into your hip stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Kneeling Jump Squat
cue: Kneel tall. Bar across your upper back. Feet flat on the floor. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Kneeling Single-Arm High Pulley Row
cue: Kneel tall. Work one arm at a time. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly.

name: Kneeling Squat
cue: Kneel tall. Sit your hips back to your heels. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Landmine 180's
cue: Stand tall. One end of the bar is anchored on the floor. Lift the bar to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Landmine Linear Jammer

name: Lateral Bound
cue: Stand tall. Jump side to side, light and quick. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Lateral Box Jump
cue: Stand tall. Touch the box lightly each time. Jump sideways up onto the box. Land with soft knees.

name: Lateral Cone Hops
cue: Stand tall. Hop side to side over the markers. Land with soft knees. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Lateral Raise - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Palms up. Lift the band up. Then lower slowly. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Latissimus Dorsi-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your side back, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Leg-Over Floor Press
cue: Lie on your back. Lie on the floor for this one. Push the kettlebell up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Leg-Up Hamstring Stretch

name: Leg Lift
cue: Stand tall. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Leg Pull-In
cue: Lie on your back. Palms forward. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Leverage Chest Press
cue: Stand tall. Push the handles forward until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Leverage Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Lift the handles by standing up tall. Then lower slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Leverage Decline Chest Press
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on a decline. Push the handles forward until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Leverage High Row
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Pull the handles. Then let it return slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Leverage Incline Chest Press
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. Push the handles forward until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Leverage Iso Row
cue: Stand tall. Each side works on its own. Palms forward. Pull the handles. Then let it return slowly.

name: Leverage Shoulder Press
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Push the handles up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Leverage Shrug
cue: Stand tall. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down. Keep your chest tall.

name: Linear Acceleration Wall Drill
cue: Stand tall. Lean into the wall, legs driving. Lift with power, then reset calmly. Keep your steps light and quick.

cue: Stand tall. Drop from the step, land, then jump straight up. Land soft, knees bent. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Log Lift
cue: Stand tall. Push your body to your chest. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: London Bridges
cue: Lie on your back. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Looking At Ceiling

name: Low Cable Triceps Extension

name: Lying Glute

name: One Arm Lat Pulldown

name: One Arm Pronated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Work one arm at a time. Palms forward. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: One Arm Supinated Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Lie back on the bench. Work one arm at a time. Palms up. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over A Bench

name: Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over A Bench

name: Prone Manual Hamstring

name: Pull Through

name: Rack Pulls

name: Rear Leg Raises

cue: Stand tall. Set up at the preacher bench. Palms forward. Curl the bar to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Reverse Cable Curl
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Curl the handle to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your elbows tucked in.

name: Reverse Crunch
cue: Lie on your back. Lift your hips and knees toward your chest. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly. Hold the top for a breath.

name: Reverse Flyes
cue: Palms facing in. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Open your arms out wide, then bring the weights back together.

name: Reverse Flyes With External Rotation
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Open your arms out wide, then bring the weights back together. A weight in each hand.

name: Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows
cue: Stand tall. Use a reverse grip. Palms up. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly.

name: Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown
cue: Stand tall. Use a reverse grip. Feet shoulder wide. Palms up. Push the handle until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
cue: Lie face down on the bench. Lift your legs behind you, together. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Reverse Machine Flyes
cue: Stand tall. Open your arms out wide, then bring the handles back together. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Reverse Plate Curls
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms forward. Curl your body up. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Reverse Triceps Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Palms up. Push the bar until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Rhomboids-SMR
cue: Lie with the roller under you. Roll slowly over your upper back, a little at a time. Pause on tender spots and breathe. Gentle pressure only.

name: Rickshaw Carry
cue: Stand tall. Pick it up and walk, tall and steady. Keep your chest tall. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Rickshaw Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Feet hip wide. Lift the weight by standing up tall. Then lower slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Ring Dips
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up.

name: Rocket Jump
cue: Stand tall. The rope reaches overhead. Jump up, using your arms to help. Land with soft knees.

name: Rocking Standing Calf Raise
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly.

name: Rocky Pull-Ups/Pulldowns
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms forward. Pull yourself up to your upper chest. Then lower yourself slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Romanian Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. The bar slides down your thighs. Palms forward. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Romanian Deadlift from Deficit
cue: Stand tall. Stand on a low step for this one. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Rope Climb
cue: Stand tall. Climb slowly, with control. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Rope Crunch
cue: Kneel tall. Hold the rope behind your head. The rope reaches overhead. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Rope Jumping
cue: Stand tall, rope in hand. Skip lightly at a steady pace. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Rope Straight-Arm Pulldown
cue: Stand tall. Arms stay long the whole way. Feet in a short stagger. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly.

name: Round The World Shoulder Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your shoulder stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Circle your arm all the way around. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Rowing, Stationary
cue: Sit on the rower, feet strapped in. Row in a steady rhythm, legs, body, then arms. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Runner's Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your back of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Running, Treadmill
cue: Step onto the treadmill. Run at a steady pace you can hold. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Russian Twist
cue: Lie on your back. Turn slowly from your middle, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return. Hold the top for a breath.

name: Sandbag Load
cue: Stand tall. Hug the bag to your chest. Lift the load up onto the platform. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Scapular Pull-Up
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms forward. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Scissor Kick
cue: Lie on your back. Scissor your legs slowly, one up, one down. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Scissors Jump
cue: Stand tall. Scissor your legs in the air. Jump and scissor your legs in the air. Land with soft knees.

name: Seated Band Hamstring Curl
cue: Sit tall. Bands add the pull. Curl your body toward the floor. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Seated Barbell Military Press
cue: Sit tall. The bar starts at your front shoulders. Palms forward. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Seated Barbell Twist
cue: Sit tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms forward. Turn slowly from your middle, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Seated Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Sit tall. Work one arm at a time. Palms facing in. Straighten your arms toward the floor, then bend slowly back.

name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
cue: Sit tall. Lift the weights toward the floor. Then lower slowly. Keep your back flat. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Seated Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Sit tall. Both arms work together. Palms facing in. Straighten your arms toward the floor, then bend slowly back.

name: Seated Biceps
cue: Sit tall. Straighten one leg up toward the sky. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Seated Cable Shoulder Press
cue: Sit tall. Push the handle up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Seated Calf Raise
cue: Sit tall. The pad rests on your thighs. Lift your heels as high as you can. Then lower slowly.

name: Seated Calf Stretch

name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
cue: Sit tall. Palms facing in. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Seated Dumbbell Inner Biceps Curl
cue: Sit tall. A weight in each hand. Palms facing in. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Palms-Down Wrist Curl
cue: Sit tall. Palms face down. Weights held at your sides. Feet shoulder wide. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Palms-Up Wrist Curl
cue: Sit tall. Palms face up. Weights held at your sides. Feet shoulder wide. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
cue: Sit tall. Push the weights up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Seated Flat Bench Leg Pull-In
cue: Sit tall. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Seated Floor Hamstring Stretch
cue: Sit tall. Reach gently down toward your toes. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Seated Front Deltoid

name: Seated Glute

cue: Sit tall. Ease into your back of thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Seated Leg Tucks

name: Single Dumbbell Raise
cue: Stand tall. Lift the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

cue: Lie on your back. Work one leg at a time. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly.

cue: Stand tall. Start with the weight overhead. Feet in a short stagger. Palms facing in. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Sled Push
cue: Stand tall. Drive the sled forward with short, strong steps. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Sled Reverse Flye
cue: Stand tall. Open your arms out wide, then bring them back together. Keep your head in line.

name: Sled Row
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Pull your body. Then let it return slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Sledgehammer Swings

name: Smith Incline Shoulder Raise

name: Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug

name: Smith Machine Close-Grip Bench Press

name: Smith Machine Decline Press

name: Smith Machine Hang Power Clean
cue: Stand tall. The bar rides the machine rails. Start from a dead hang. Palms forward. Lift the handles up. Then lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Hip Raise
cue: Lie back on the bench. The bar rides the machine rails. Lift the handles up. Then lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Push the handles up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Smith Machine Leg Press

name: Smith Machine Pistol Squat

name: Smith Machine Reverse Calf Raises

name: Smith Machine Stiff-Legged Deadlift

name: Smith Machine Upright Row

name: Smith Single-Leg Split Squat
cue: Stand tall. The bar rides the machine rails. Work one leg at a time. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Snatch

name: Snatch Balance
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Catch it overhead and steady yourself. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Snatch Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Snatch Pull
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Snatch Shrug
cue: Stand tall. Catch it overhead in one smooth move. Palms forward. Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears, then let them sink back down.

name: Snatch from Blocks

name: Speed Band Overhead Triceps

name: Speed Box Squat
cue: Stand tall. Touch the box lightly each time. Move with speed, still in control. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Speed Squats
cue: Stand tall. Move with speed, still in control. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Spell Caster
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Palms forward. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Spider Crawl
cue: Stand tall. Feet together. Crawl slowly, with control. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Spider Curl

name: Spinal Stretch

name: Split Jerk

name: Split Jump

name: Split Snatch

name: Split Squat with Dumbbells
cue: Stand tall. Feet in a long stagger. A weight in each hand. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Split Squats

name: Squat Jerk

name: Squat with Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Squat with Chains
cue: Stand tall. Chains hang from the bar. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Squat with Plate Movers
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Feet together. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Squats - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. The rope rests beside your face. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Stairmaster

name: Standing Alternating Dumbbell Press

name: Standing Barbell Calf Raise

name: Standing Barbell Press Behind Neck

name: Standing Bent-Over One-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension

name: Standing Bent-Over Two-Arm Dumbbell Triceps Extension

name: Standing Biceps Cable Curl

name: Standing Biceps Stretch

name: Standing Cable Chest Press

name: Standing Cable Lift

name: Standing Cable Wood Chop

name: Standing Concentration Curl

name: Standing Dumbbell Calf Raise

name: Standing Dumbbell Triceps Extension
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Only your forearms move.

name: Standing Dumbbell Upright Row
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Palms forward. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Standing Elevated Quad Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Lift one leg behind you. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Standing Front Barbell Raise Over Head

name: Standing Hamstring and Calf Stretch

name: Standing Hip Circles

name: Standing Hip Flexors

name: Standing Inner-Biceps Curl
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Palms up. Curl the weights up. Then lower slowly.

name: Standing Lateral Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Lean gently to one side. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Standing Leg Curl
cue: Stand tall. Curl the handles up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Standing Long Jump

name: Standing Low-Pulley Deltoid Raise
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms forward. Lift the handle up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Standing One-Arm Cable Curl
