cue: Stand tall. Both arms work together. Throw the ball down with your whole body. Land soft, knees bent.

name: Star Jump
cue: Stand tall. Spread your arms and legs wide in the air. Jump up, using your arms to help. Land with soft knees.

name: Step-up with Knee Raise
cue: Stand tall. Feet together. Lift your hips up high. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Step Mill
cue: Step onto the stepper. Climb at a steady pace you can keep. The steps roll like a slow escalator.

name: Stiff-Legged Barbell Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Legs stay nearly straight. Palms forward. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Legs stay nearly straight. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Stiff Leg Barbell Good Morning
cue: Stand tall. Bar across your upper back. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Stomach Vacuum
cue: Stand tall. Ease into your tummy stretch until you feel a gentle pull. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Straight-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
cue: Stand tall. Arms stay long the whole way. Pull the weights. Then let it return slowly.

name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
cue: Stand tall. Arms stay long the whole way. Palms forward. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly.

name: Straight Bar Bench Mid Rows
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Straight Raises on Incline Bench
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on an incline. Palms forward. Lift the bar up. Then lower slowly.

name: Stride Jump Crossover
cue: Stand tall. Jump in a long stride. Jump up, using your arms to help. Land with soft knees.

name: Sumo Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Take a wide stance, toes turned out. Palms forward. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Sumo Deadlift with Bands
cue: Palms forward. Stand tall. Take a wide stance, toes turned out. Bands add the pull. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Sumo Deadlift with Chains
cue: Stand tall. Chains hang from the bar. Take a wide stance, toes turned out. Lift the bar by standing up tall. Then lower slowly.

name: Superman
cue: Lie face down. Ease into your lower back stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Supine Chest Throw
cue: Lie on your back. Throw the ball from your chest with your whole body. Land soft, knees bent.

name: Supine One-Arm Overhead Throw
cue: Lie on your back. Work one arm at a time. Throw the ball down with your whole body. Land soft, knees bent.

name: Supine Two-Arm Overhead Throw
cue: Lie on your back. Both arms work together. Throw the ball down with your whole body. Land soft, knees bent.

name: Suspended Fallout
cue: Face down, hands under your shoulders. Pull your knees in toward your tummy. Then stretch your legs back out slowly.

name: Suspended Push-Up
cue: Stand tall. Your heels rest on the floor, body at an angle. Push your body until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Suspended Reverse Crunch
cue: Stand tall. Your heels rest on the floor, body at an angle. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Suspended Row
cue: Stand tall. Your heels rest on the floor, body at an angle. Pull your body. Then let it return slowly.

name: Suspended Split Squat
cue: Stand tall. Your heels rest on the floor, body at an angle. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Svend Press
cue: Stand tall. Push your body to your chest. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return. Pause at the top.

name: T-Bar Row with Handle
cue: Stand tall. Straddle the bar, handle in both hands. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly.

name: Tate Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. A weight in each hand. Feet shoulder wide. Push the weights until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: The Straddle
cue: Stand tall. Fold forward slowly from your hips. Feel it in your back of thigh. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Thigh Abductor
cue: Sit tall. Push your legs apart against the pads. Then let them come back slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Thigh Adductor
cue: Sit tall. Squeeze your legs together against the pads. Then open back out slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Tire Flip
cue: Stand tall. Grip the tread and drive it over. Lift and flip it over, then reset your grip.

name: Toe Touchers
cue: Lie on your back. Reach gently down toward your toes. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Torso Rotation
cue: Stand tall. Turn your body slowly to one side. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch. Keep your eyes forward.

name: Trail Running/Walking
cue: Head out on the trail. Run at a steady pace you can hold. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Trap Bar Deadlift
cue: Stand tall. Lift the weight by standing up tall. Then lower slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: Tricep Dumbbell Kickback
cue: Stand tall. A weight in each hand. Palms up. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back.

name: Tricep Side Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Reach one arm across your body. Then swap sides. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Triceps Overhead Extension with Rope
cue: Stand tall. Start with the weight overhead. Straighten your arms, then bend slowly back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment
cue: Stand tall. Palms facing in. Push the handle until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Triceps Pushdown - V-Bar Attachment
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Push the handle until your arms are long. Then lower slowly. Only your forearms move.

name: Triceps Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Reach one hand behind your head and ease the elbow back. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Tuck Crunch
cue: Lie on your back. Palms forward. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl
cue: Both arms work together. Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. Set up at the preacher bench. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean
cue: Stand tall. Catch the bar on your front shoulders. Both arms work together. Lift the kettlebell up. Then lower slowly.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Jerk
cue: Stand tall. Both arms work together. Lift the bar to your shoulders, then dip and drive it overhead. Then lower slowly.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Military Press
cue: Stand tall. Both arms work together. Push the kettlebell up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Two-Arm Kettlebell Row
cue: Stand tall. Both arms work together. One weight in each hand. Pull the kettlebell. Then let it return slowly.

name: Underhand Cable Pulldowns
cue: Sit tall. Palms up. Pull the handle to your upper chest. Then let it return slowly.

name: Upper Back-Leg Grab
cue: Stand tall. Fold forward slowly from your hips. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch. Feel it in your upper back.

name: Upper Back Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Round your back slowly. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Upright Barbell Row
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Upright Cable Row
cue: Stand tall. Palms up. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Keep your body tall and still.

name: Upright Row - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Bands add the pull. Palms up. Pull the band. Then let it return slowly.

name: Upward Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Reach both hands up high. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch. Keep your back flat.

name: V-Bar Pulldown
cue: Sit tall. Palms facing in. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly. Keep your chest tall.

name: V-Bar Pullup
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms facing in. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Vertical Swing
cue: Stand tall. Swing with power, then reset calmly. Land with soft knees. Keep your back flat.

name: Walking, Treadmill
cue: Step onto the treadmill. Walk at a steady pace you can keep. Breathe easy, and stop whenever you need a rest.

name: Weighted Ball Hyperextension
cue: Lie face down on the bench. Wear the added weight. Lift your legs behind you, together. Then lower slowly.

name: Weighted Ball Side Bend
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Wear the added weight. Lift the ball up. Then lower slowly.

name: Weighted Bench Dip
cue: Stand tall. Wear the added weight. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then push back up.

name: Weighted Crunches
cue: Lie back on the bench. Wear the added weight. Feet flat on the floor. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Weighted Jump Squat
cue: Stand tall. Explode up from the start. Wear the added weight. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Weighted Pull Ups
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Wear the added weight. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Weighted Sissy Squat
cue: Stand tall. Lean back as your knees bend. Wear the added weight. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Weighted Sit-Ups - With Bands
cue: Stand tall. Set the bench on a decline. Bands add the pull. Palms facing in. Curl your head and shoulders up, then lower slowly.

name: Weighted Squat
cue: Stand tall. Wear the added weight. Feet shoulder wide. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Wide-Grip Barbell Bench Press
cue: Lie back on the bench. Grip wide, palms forward. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Bench Press
cue: Grip wide, palms forward. Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Push the bar up until your arms are long. Then lower slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Pullover
cue: Lie back on the bench. Set the bench on a decline. Feet shoulder wide. Pull the bar. Then let it return slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
cue: Sit tall. Grip wide, palms forward. Pull the handle to your upper chest. Then let it return slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Pulldown Behind The Neck
cue: Sit tall. The bar rests behind your neck. Grip wide, palms forward. Pull the handle. Then let it return slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Grip wide, palms forward. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Then lower yourself slowly.

name: Wide-Grip Standing Barbell Curl
cue: Stand tall. Grip wide. Curl the bar up. Then lower slowly. Keep your upper arms still.

name: Wide Stance Barbell Squat
cue: Stand tall. Take a wide stance. Bar across your upper back. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Wide Stance Stiff Legs
cue: Stand tall. Take a wide stance. Hinge forward from your hips, chest tall, then stand up tall.

name: Wind Sprints
cue: Hang from the bar, arms long. Palms forward. Run slowly, with control. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Windmills
cue: Lie on your back. Ease into your outer thigh stretch. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: World's Greatest Stretch
cue: Stand tall. Bend your knees, feet flat. Hold it there and breathe. Gentle only, never force a stretch.

name: Wrist Circles
cue: Stand tall. Circle your wrist slowly, then the other way. Keep it slow and easy both ways.

name: Wrist Roller
cue: Stand tall. Feet shoulder wide. Palms forward. Lift your body up. Then lower slowly. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Wrist Rotations with Straight Bar
cue: Stand tall. Palms forward. Turn the bar slowly to one side, then turn back. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Yoke Walk
cue: Stand tall. The frame rests on your shoulders. Walk tall and steady, arms swinging easy. Breathe out as you move, in as you return.

name: Zercher Squats
cue: Stand tall. The bar rests in the crook of your elbows. Sit your hips back and down, then stand up tall.

name: Zottman Curl
cue: Stand tall. Turn your palms down as you lower. A weight in each hand. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.

name: Zottman Preacher Curl
cue: Palms forward. Stand tall. Set the bench on an incline. Set up at the preacher bench. Curl the weights to shoulder height. Then lower slowly.
